in_sanskrit.name: Ila
in_sanskrit.meaning: She who wears the crest or mark of Shiva
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ila is derived from the Sanskrit word इल (ila) meaning crest or mark. In Hindu mythology, Ila is the wife of Lord Shiva, who wears the crescent moon as her mark. It is believed that the name Ilina might be a modern variation of the name Ila.

in_hindi.name: ईलिना
in_hindi.meaning: Modern name, likely derived from Sanskrit Ila
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ilina is a modern name in India, likely derived from the Sanskrit name Ila (ईला), which means 'She who wears the crest or mark of Shiva'. The name Ila is associated with the goddess Ila, who is the wife of Lord Shiva and is known for her connection to the moon.

in_marathi.name: Ilina
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Daughter of the Mountain God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ilina हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ilina is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Ila', meaning 'mountain'. The name Ilina signifies 'Daughter of the Mountain God'. In Hindu mythology, mountains are considered sacred and are often personified as deities. The name Ilina evokes a sense of strength, stability, and connection to nature.
